shinshapa-tree.alt: रात में शीशम का टेढ़ा पेड़, डाल से लटकी एक आकृति
shinshapa-tree.prompt: A twisted shinshapa tree in a moonless cremation ground; from one branch a shrouded figure hangs, turning slowly, seen at a distance; King Vikram stands below looking up.

night-walk.alt: कंधे पर बेताल को लादे श्मशान से गुज़रते राजा विक्रम
night-walk.prompt: King Vikram walks through a cremation ground at night carrying Betal over his shoulder; Betal's mouth is close to the king's ear; small fires far off, a dark swirling sky.

riddle.alt: रुके हुए क़दम; राजा के कान के पास बेताल का चेहरा
riddle.prompt: Close view: King Vikram halted mid-step, eyes narrowed in thought, Betal's face beside his ear waiting; everything else fallen into deep still darkness.

verdict.alt: चलते हुए फ़ैसला सुनाते राजा विक्रम
verdict.prompt: King Vikram walking and speaking with calm certainty, one hand raised in reasoning, Betal on his shoulder listening; a single pyre glows behind.

betal-argues.alt: कंधे पर से बहस करता, हँसता बेताल
betal-argues.prompt: Close view: Betal leaning forward from the king's shoulder, arguing with lively mocking hands; King Vikram looks straight ahead, listening.

flight.alt: हवा में उड़कर शीशम की ओर लौटता बेताल
flight.prompt: Betal flies laughing back through the night sky toward the distant shinshapa tree, cloth streaming; below, King Vikram turns, his shoulder suddenly empty.
